g.text: Peer i is one of four non-initiator roles; the initiator may occupy any active setup position.
Approval collections remain in setup peer order.
Guards and detailed-message coverage are in withdrawal_development_contracts.md.
Receive and review the initiator proposal
WN-OFFER-1 withdrawal_id, initiator TxApproval, recipient-encrypted PSBTs
Prevalidate visible signer membership, matching withdrawal_id, freshness, milestone eligibility,
schema, bounds, and transaction-independent properties under G-NONINITIATOR-OFFER.
WN-OFFER-3 proposal and current local block height
Decrypt PSBT; recompute withdrawal_id from active setup, tx_id, initiator identity, and approval nonce.
Validate PSBT and reconstructed withdrawal_id before presentation
WN-APPROVE-1 withdrawal_id and Enc_WT(Sig_Boomlet_i(TxApproval_i)) via Niso
WN-APPROVE-2 corresponding TxApproval_j from other non-initiators
Accept under G-TX-APPROVAL-COLLECTION; canonicalize in setup peer order
Reconstruct full set with stored initiator approval; prevalidate under G-APPROVAL-SET-AT-PEER
WN-APPROVE-4 four non-initiator approvals and current local block height
Reconstruct and revalidate the exact ordered five-approval set under G-APPROVAL-SET-AT-PEER.
approved_withdrawal_id := H(withdrawal_id, exact ordered five-approval set).
Prepare a fresh phase-bound placeholder; commitment remains gated on the initiator acknowledgment.
Compute ApprovalSetAttestation from the ordered five approvals and WtTxApproval.
The attestation proves receipt, verification, and agreement on approved_withdrawal_id.
WN-COMMIT-3 staged initiator TxCommit_0 and Placeholder_0
G-APPROVAL-ATTESTATIONS opens only with all four matching non-initiator attestations.
The open gate permits initiator placeholder relay and initiator commit acknowledgment.
WN-COMMIT-4 initiator Placeholder_0 to the initiator's setup-bound SAR
WN-COMMIT-7 acknowledged initiator commit and current local block height
Only this accepted event authorizes creation of TxCommit_i.
WN-COMMIT-9 Placeholder_i to peer i's setup-bound SAR
Accept and durably process under G-SAR-PLACEHOLDER; release at the fixed observable deadline
Accept commit and SAR acknowledgment under G-TX-COMMIT-AT-WT
WN-COMMIT-11 complete WT-signed TxCommit set and acknowledgment_i
WN-COMMIT-12 complete set, acknowledgment_i, current local block height
Revalidate complete set and exact own acknowledgment under G-COMMIT-COLLECTION.
Draw one fresh private mystery only on DIGGING entry and initialize digging state.
Continue with the common digging, reached-collection, signing, export, and reset sequence
in the WI-DIG, WI-FINAL, WI-SIGN, and WI-RELAY groups of
Apply the same peer-local guards with peer i as the recipient.
Invalid identity, signature, envelope, nonce, ceremony binding, sequence, block-height relation,
collection, transaction, or state transition stalls the active ceremony.
